summary: Nauticus Robotics filed an 8-K disclosing a non-binding LOI with an unnamed strategic investor for a private placement equity investment of up to $50 million. No price per share, stake percentage, premium or timetable were stated; the company cautions the investment could cause dilution and/or a change of control. The board is evaluating the proposal consistent with fiduciary duties and is considering engaging advisers. The LOI is non-binding, with funding subject to diligence, definitive agreements, approvals and closing conditions. Watch for a definitive securities purchase agreement, pricing/valuation, possible control premium or reverse-split, and Nasdaq compliance/dilution overhang risk.
